data.title: Choose the sentence that uses the word correctly.

sections.title: backpack
sections.question: backpack
sections.summary: a bag that you carry on your back

senses.definition: a large bag that you carry on your back, used for school, travel, or walking
examples: She puts her books and lunch in her backpack every morning.
He carries his backpack to school every day.

answers.answer: She puts her books in her backpack before going to school.
He eats his backpack for breakfast every morning.
She drives her backpack to work because the office is far away.
They plant a backpack in the garden every spring.

sections.title: bag
sections.question: bag
sections.summary: a container made of cloth, paper, or leather for carrying things

senses.definition: a container made of cloth, leather, or plastic that you use to carry things
examples: She puts her phone and keys in her bag.

answers.answer: She puts her phone and keys in her bag.
He cooks his bag in the oven for dinner.
She drinks a bag of water every morning.
They plant a bag in the garden to grow food.

sections.title: bed
